entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The man in the center with a small mustache and side-parted brown hair, wearing a dark purple tailcoat, white shirt, black bow tie, light gray waistcoat, and trousers, and holding an open small booklet.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The young man closely following at the image-right rear of Person A, wearing a dark purple stand-collar uniform and a cylindrical hat of the same color.

entities.name: red patterned carpet
entities.identification: The red and light pink carpeting in the lobby passage and seating area, with light-colored borders and repeating patterns.

entities.name: large potted palm
entities.identification: The group of tall plants on the left side of the lobby, with dark green, outward-spreading pinnate leaves.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The man initially on the left side of Person A, with longer dark hair, wearing a dark long coat and holding a small light-colored rectangular object.

entities.name: Person E
entities.identification: The man holding an ivory-white bouquet on the left side of the image, wearing a long purple uniform and a dark tall hat, with bright-colored buttons on his chest.

entities.name: cream-pink wall and arched niche
entities.identification: The light warm-colored walls on the right side and in the depth of the lobby, with rectangular sections, light-colored borders, and arched areas.

entities.name: golden-brown stone-faced column
entities.identification: The tall golden-brown column on the left side of the passage, with light and dark surface textures, vertical dividing lines, and a dark base.

entities.name: warm-white globe lights and wall lights
entities.identification: The groups of warm-white globe lights hanging above the lobby, as well as the light fixtures on the walls and along the arch edges.

entities.name: wood-framed upholstered chair in the lobby
entities.identification: The groups of dark wood-framed armchairs in the seating area on the right, with light beige to brown upholstery.

entities.name: small round table in the lobby
entities.identification: The small dark round tables in front of or between the seats on the right, with cups and saucers on the tabletops.

entities.name: guests and staff in the background
entities.identification: The group of people standing or seated in the distance and on the right side of the lobby, excluding Person A, Person B, Person C, and Person E.

entities.name: metallic round flowerpot
entities.identification: The cylindrical container beneath the palm, brown-and-gold in color and with glossy reflections.

entities.name: light-colored bouquet held by the attendant
entities.identification: The bouquet held in front of Person E's chest, composed of ivory-white flowers and dark green leaves.

entities.name: light-colored ceiling
entities.identification: The light warm-colored ceiling above the lobby, with flat panels, rectangular sections, and decorative lines along the edges.

entities.name: geometric-patterned floor
entities.identification: The flooring area exposed beyond the edge of the red carpet, with a light-colored base and dark repeating geometric patterns.

entities.name: cups and saucers on the tabletop
entities.identification: The light-colored cups and saucers and small glossy reflective vessels on the small round table on the right.
